A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enantioselective exo-radical cyclizations are more efficient than the endo-cyclizations, which is the opposite of the situation in the thermal Diels-Alder reactions of quinolone dienes.
the complexing agent is not only able to transfer chirality but also that it is able to increase the enantiomeric excess of the products.
the chiral complex 1 is a powerful chiral catalyst for radical cyclization reactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
chiral ligands can be used as a source of chirality in the cyclization reaction of achiral precursors.
chiral complexing agents can be employed in the radical cyclization of quinolones in the presence of catalytic amounts of the complexing agent to achieve high enantioselectivity.
the complexation of a chiral ligand with a radical precursor can result in a significant enantioselectivity in a subsequent radical reaction.
